name: splatoon3-bot
description: Deterministic Splatoon 3 screenshots and native rich notifications

scripts.check: pnpm run check:syntax && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build
scripts.check:syntax: find bot scripts src -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:browser-ci && pnpm run test:visual
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/run-plan.test.mjs tests/run-manifest.test.mjs tests/run-content-preflight.test.mjs tests/data-snapshot.test.mjs tests/bot-run-report.test.mjs tests/browser-runtime.test.mjs tests/actionlint.test.mjs tests/screenshot-runner.test.mjs tests/fixture-localization.test.mjs tests/content-availability.test.mjs tests/time.test.mjs tests/i18n-runtime.test.mjs tests/upstream-regressions.test.mjs tests/contact-sheet.test.mjs tests/bot-context.test.mjs tests/bot-configuration.test.mjs tests/workflow-policy.test.mjs tests/remote-image-inspector.test.mjs tests/notification-composer.test.mjs tests/notification-channels.test.mjs tests/notification-payload-golden.test.mjs tests/notification-delivery.test.mjs tests/delivery-ledger.test.mjs tests/notification-digest.test.mjs tests/event-alert.test.mjs tests/notification-report.test.mjs tests/s3-publisher.test.mjs
